headline: Profits doubled, momentum intact
chart_note: 52-week range: $105.30 - $174.09. Currently $159.47, up about 55% over the past year but roughly 8% off the 52-week high.
why_today: Q2 net income more than doubled YoY to $14.5B on rising oil prices, record Permian Basin output, and a sharp turnaround in refining - revenue of $114.5B beat estimates of $109.9B by a wide margin.
pro_1: Analyst consensus is Buy (75% buy rating from 30 analysts) on the back of the earnings beat
pro_2: Forward PE of roughly 13.8x is notably cheaper than the trailing 21.4x, reflecting expected continued earnings growth
con_1: Energy earnings are tied to oil prices staying elevated - a commodity swing can reverse the momentum quickly
con_2: Stock is already up 55% over 12 months, so a lot of the good news may already be reflected in the price
